common_atlas_binding_runtime_rest_valida.basis: For each canonical owner record, compare the record's rest-body translation and rotation-scale map with the registration global source transform expressed in the NHSKIN metre coordinates; source positions and the canonical records are not equated to NHTISS owner-local transforms.

evidence_boundary: The source edit is inferred reference anatomy. Geometry audit covers the listed nine captured poses only; contact geometry/Jacobians may change, so native physiological response remains unqualified.

geometry_registration.interpretation: Inferred reference geometry. The QP proposes a bounded local reduction of the earlier clearance candidate; exact geometry audit is separate. No measured tissue thickness or clinical clearance claim.
geometry_registration.method: inferred common-atlas source-position reduction within the previously selected local support

owner_composition.qualification: composed candidate; combined native pose and exact intersection audits pending

canonical_binding_reference.meaning: authoritative canonical shared-atlas NHSKIN bindings and vertex weights; per-owner binding substitutions from intermediate inputs are rejected and restored from these exact records

raw_FJ2810.interpretation: raw source mesh; candidate positions are inferred registered geometry, not measured source coordinates

method: Existing NHSKIN source-position composition, using the 004 per-vertex reduction after exact 9-pose audit.
